div.div:
Routing strategies
• Round-robin / weighted
• Least-latency
• Cost-optimized
• Smart (intent-aware, leaderboard)
• Ensemble (panel → quorum → synthesis)
• Fallback chain with exponential backoff

div.div:
Policy hierarchy (inheritance)
org → business unit → project → env
Budget: MIN (tightest wins)
Rate limit: MIN
Allowed models: INTERSECTION
PII redaction: OR (cannot be disabled)
PII types: UNION

div.div:
Security pipeline
• Unicode NFKD normalization
• Homoglyph-resistant injection patterns
• Streaming PII buffer (split tokens)
• SHA-256 hash-chain audit trail
(head reloaded on restart)
• Event dispatch: webhook / SNS

• Filter: health → model availability
• Active-passive failover
• Active-active weighted
• Data-residency zones

(skipped when single-region)

div.div:
True streaming (SSE)
• Opens provider stream directly —
no blocking call, no double billing
• Pre-first-byte provider fallback
• Usage merged at end of stream
• PII re-injected per chunk
